notes.facility_name:
The body never names the tranche: the defined terms are "Commitment", "Committed Loans", and "Aggregate Commitments". The only label is the cover page, printed as two centered lines: "Senior Unsecured" / "Revolving Credit Facility" (separate

elements in the HTML). Value recorded under the cover-page rule in schema.md, which takes the cover-page label excluding ranking and security descriptors.
notes.sublimits_not_booked: L/C Sublimit $400,000,000; Swing Line Sublimit $150,000,000; Canadian Dollar Sublimit $1,000,000,000 (lesser of that and Aggregate Commitments). Each is defined as "part of, and not in addition to, the Aggregate Commitments". Canadian Bankers' Acceptances are a borrowing form under the same Commitment, not a tranche. No records created.
notes.accordion_not_booked: s.2.16 permits increases up to $2,100,000,000 aggregate (min $50M each). Option, not commitment.
notes.schedule_2_01_reconciliation: 20 lenders x $64,000,000 + 2 lenders x $35,000,000 = $1,350,000,000. Schedule and defined term agree; no discrepancy.
notes.maturity: No hard date anywhere in the document; Closing Date is defined as the date s.4.01 conditions are satisfied, not as a calendar date, hence basis=relative. Recorded in the structured form {tenor_years, anchor} required by schema.md. The "later of" limb (b) is the s.2.14 one-year extension mechanic (Company may request once per calendar year; each Lender extends at its discretion), i.e. an extension option analogous to ordinary termination limbs, not a springing maturity. No springing-maturity proviso present.
notes.benchmark: Multicurrency definition: Dollar loans off LIBOR (Reuters screen), Canadian Dollar loans off CDOR. Recorded the primary limb per schema rule (libor). "Benchmark" is defined as "initially, LIBOR". Term SOFR / Daily Simple SOFR appear only in the Benchmark Replacement fallback definitions and s.3.03(c) (conditional, not operative).
notes.applicable_margin: Ratings grid, five Pricing Levels, Eurocurrency Rate Loans / Letters of Credit / Canadian BA margin column: L1 (A-/A3 or higher) 1.000%, L2 (BBB+/Baa1) 1.125%, L3 (BBB/Baa2) 1.250%, L4 (BBB-/Baa3) 1.500%, L5 (BB+/Ba1 or lower) 1.750%. Base Rate / Canadian Prime margin column runs 0.000%-0.750%. Commitment fee column runs 0.100%-0.300%. Opening level is expressly deferred to the Debt Rating certified in the closing certificate under s.4.01(a)(vii)(C) ("the current Debt Ratings"); no rating is stated anywhere in the document. Deferral null with the deferral sentence cited, per schema rule. The Level 5 fallback in the Debt Rating definition applies only if the Company has no Debt Rating at all and is not an opening-level statement.
notes.has_margin_grid: Margin varies with Debt Rating across five levels -> true. The commitment fee also steps on the same grid, which is noted but does not drive the field.
notes.covenant_type: Classified by definition, not label. Consolidated Funded Indebtedness = long-term indebtedness + revolving/term borrowings + Capital Leases, excluding L/C indebtedness, Cash and Carry Purchase financing, and margin deposits; it does not subtract cash or cash equivalents, so no netting -> total_leverage_gross (not total_net_leverage). Facility is senior unsecured, so first-lien/secured variants do not apply. s.7.08 additionally excludes Hybrid Securities up to 15% of Consolidated Total Capitalization from Consolidated Funded Indebtedness for covenant purposes.
notes.initial_threshold: s.7.08 table has two rows: (i) During an Acquisition Period 5.50:1.0; (ii) Other than during an Acquisition Period 5.00:1.0. Row (i) is an acquisition holiday (Acquisition Period: from funding of a Specified Acquisition of >= $150M, ending at the earliest of the third following fiscal quarter end, a Specified Equity Offering, or the Company's election). Recorded the non-holiday level 5.00 per schema rule; holiday level 5.50 noted here.
notes.step_down_schedule: Confirmed flat. The table is keyed to Acquisition Period status, not to fiscal periods; there is no time-based change to the 5.00x level for the life of the agreement.
notes.covenant_ebitda_addbacks: Consolidated EBITDA may include Material Project EBITDA Adjustments (projects >= $50M, capped at 15% of actual Consolidated EBITDA, JV-project portion capped at 7.5%). Definitional, does not affect any scored field.
notes.springing_trigger: Covenant is tested unconditionally as of the end of every fiscal quarter; no utilization or availability proviso, no Covenant Trigger Event / Testing Period defined term. Absence null, no citation required.
notes.other_covenants_checked: No interest coverage, fixed charge coverage, net worth, liquidity, or capex covenant. Article VII contains only s.7.08 as a financial ratio covenant. Covenant list is complete at one entry.
notes.filing_date: 2021-08-26, from the EDGAR index for accession 0001104659-21-109833. Distinct from the agreement date of 2021-08-20, which is what the exhibit itself states.
